user_story:
As a user, I want to be able to check and uncheck checkboxes so that I can indicate my preferences. The system should maintain the state of the checkboxes when I refresh the page. 

Acceptance Criteria:
1. I can see the heading 'Checkboxes' on the page.
2. There are two checkboxes present on the form with the id 'checkboxes'.
3. The checkboxes can be checked and unchecked by the user.
4. The state of the checkboxes should be visually represented after the interaction.
